title: Stationary NPC flat visual voice-age catalog
basis: Manual visual review of native flat contact sheets. Age is a voice-design estimate from visible sprite cues, not canon age or exact years. Captions, NPC roles, names, and apparent species/size were not used as age evidence. Unclear/nonhuman/obscured figures default to unknown; confidence is low where palette pixels or face detail are insufficient.

coverage.exclusionReason: Archive 199 records are quest marker UI graphics, not NPC sprite artwork.
coverage.scopeNote: This is the existing flat-appearance inventory for these archives, not a claim that every possible static NPC appearance across every archive is covered.
